description: C-47B-30-DK (c/n 13821, ex USAAF 43-30670, FAB 2035 1946-74, then VOTEC and RICO Táxi Aéreo as PT-KYX) trucked from Roraima and set up as a 'crashed expedition aircraft' on the camp's paleontology trail; the park's own site (2026) still calls the DC-3 one of its most admired attractions. Access is for booked school/holiday camp groups, not walk-up.
